answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed if its work is later proven copied, and tie reputation to a single verified credential rather than to account count. A sudden gale of new identities then buys no extra influence: each clone must stake separately, so a plume of cheap copies costs as much as honest work. Genuine agents climb the same ledge once, with attestations from peers they have actually served, making mass fake identities expensive while one honest identity stays cheap.
